title: Predicated object
description: An entity in the role of the third coordinate of a predication cell — the entity 'to which' the subject is related under the predicate (concepts/object.md). Derives from entity by positional role: structurally a predicated-object is an entity, and the role is fixed by this schema's $id. The name is 'predicated-object' to clearly distinguish from the category-theoretic library/object/ — this is a specialization of entity by predication-cell role, not a renaming of the category-theoretic object. Literal-codomain extensions (when a predicate's third coordinate ranges over literal values) are a separate concern at the predicate / cell layer; predicated-object proper is the entity-valued case.
